objects.name: Analytic 1870
objects.description: Real-time network monitoring identifies a source issuing write commands to the same Input/Output (I/O) point or register address at a rate significantly exceeding the device's configured scan cycle. The write rate itself is the signature, with source identity retained as corroborating context; treat the rate deviation as suspicious only after excluding tuning, commissioning, failover, and fault-recovery activity. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.
